def ossl_provider_up_ref_parent(prov, activate):
    """
    ossl_provider_up_ref_parent() and ossl_provider_free_parent() do
    nothing in "self-referencing" child providers, i.e. when the parent
    of the child provider is the same as the provider where this child
    provider was created.
    This allows the teardown function in the parent provider to be called
    at the correct moment.
    For child providers in other providers, the reference count is done to
    ensure that cross referencing is recorded.  These should be cleared up
    through that providers teardown, as part of freeing its child libctx.
    """
    if prov.parent == prov:
        return

    c_prov_up_ref = prov.parent.libctx.load_dynamic_function(
        b"OSSL_PROVIDER_up_ref", prov.parent.handle
    )
    c_prov_free = prov.parent.libctx.load_dynamic_function(
        b"OSSL_PROVIDER_free", prov.parent.handle
    )

    if activate:
        c_prov_up_ref(prov.parent.handle)
    else:
        c_prov_free(prov.parent.handle)

    """
    OSSL_PROVIDER *ossl_provider_up_ref_parent(OSSL_PROVIDER *prov, int activate)

    :return: The parent provider.
    """
    if prov.parent == prov:
        return prov
    
    parent_handle = prov.handle
    parent_prov = ossl_provider_find(parent_handle, prov.libctx)
    if parent_prov == NULL:
        return NULL

    if c_prov_up_ref == NULL or c_prov_free == NULL:
        return NULL
    
    if activate:
        c_prov_up_ref(parent_prov)
    
    return parent_prov
